primary_task: Create an Earth2Studio prognostic model wrapper (earth2studio/models/px/<name>.py) with its tests, pyproject extra, docs and changelog, and run the mock and package tests plus make format and lint.

requirements.name: uv
requirements.evidence: **⚠️ CRITICAL:** Always use `uv run` for Python commands
requirements.basis: bash: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads)"; egress_allow includes "pypi.org"

requirements.name: pytest and earth2studio Python dependencies (torch, numpy, loguru)
make
requirements.evidence: Run: `make format && make lint` / make format && make lint && make license
requirements.basis: bash: "build, test, run CLIs and scripts" on Linux x86_64 (make is standard Linux build software; also obtainable from Ubuntu apt)

requirements.name: earth2studio repository checkout
requirements.basis: grants: "local_filesystem"; egress_allow includes "github.com" (a clone can be obtained if not already in the working directory)

requirements.name: huggingface.co
requirements.evidence: **`load_default_package`:** Lock HuggingFace URLs: `hf://org/repo@commit` / `test_<model>_package` | Real weights (`@pytest.mark.package`) / uv run pytest test/models/px/test_<name>.py::test_<model>_package --package -v / Do not omit the package test. ... while still loading real weights and running a forward pass.
requirements.basis: egress_deny: "huggingface.co"; lacks: "network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list: only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused, for example huggingface.co, Microsoft Learn and Azure endpoints, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA"

requirements.name: reference inference script URL
requirements.evidence: Step 0 -- Get Reference Script: If `$ARGUMENTS` provided, use it. Otherwise ask: Please provide a reference inference script URL/path.
requirements.basis: web_fetch: "fetch a web page or unauthenticated API by URL; hosts outside the egress allow-list are refused". A GitHub URL (as in the Pangu example) or a local path is available; any other host is refused. Depends on the user's input.

requirements.name: ask_user
requirements.evidence: **[CONFIRM]** Present dependencies and ask user to approve.
requirements.basis: ask_user: "ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation"

notes: Reading taken: Step 7 is a required step ('Do these steps IN ORDER. Do not skip any step.') and it runs the package test, which must load real weights ('Do not omit the package test'); Step 6 locks the weights to HuggingFace URLs, and huggingface.co is refused, so the package test cannot pass. Other reading: if only writing the package test is required and running the mock tests (-m "not package") is enough, or if the model's checkpoint is hosted on GitHub, every hard requirement is available or installable and the verdict is ACHIEVABLE. The reference-script URL status is unknown (depends on the host the user gives). No GPU is required: tests parametrize device and load with map_location="cpu". Optional Steps 8, 10 and 11 (register, validation plots, PR) are outside the primary task; the PR step would also hit forbid_effects "publishes"/"writes_external".
